title: Fiber Offer v1 (signed)
description: The shape of a signed fiberoffer-v1 offer in canonical form (docs/spec-v1.md, section 2). An offer that does not match this schema is not a valid offer. One that matches is not thereby valid: its offer_id and signature must still be recomputed and checked (spec 4.3), and the rules listed in README.md under 'What the schemas do not check' still apply.

description.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes, which this schema can only bound as 512 characters. No leading or trailing white space; the pattern lists the white space characters themselves (ECMAScript WhiteSpace and LineTerminator), because \s does not mean the same in every regular expression engine.

assets.description: No asset is listed twice: two entries with the same asset_type and type_script_hash are the same asset whatever their symbols, which is stricter than uniqueItems.

expiry.description: Unix seconds. Invoice requests are refused once the current time is greater than it.

^x_.description: An extension field: any signable JSON value except null.

allOf.description: An offer is not both single-use and recurring.
Plain http only on the dev network, or for a loopback address.

resolverUrl.description: Scheme, host, an optional non-default port and plain path segments; no trailing slash, credentials, query, fragment or percent-encoding. Spec 2.2. The pattern is the grammar. What it does not say: that an IPv4 address is a dotted quad of numbers up to 255, that an IPv6 literal is a real address in RFC 5952 form, and that a host whose last label is a number is an IPv4 address.

allOf.description: The port is never the scheme's default.

recurrence.description: Spec 11. amount lies within amount_min and amount_max, and spending_cap_total is at least amount; neither comparison can be written here.

freeFormObject.description: metadata and extensions: a JSON object of content this format does not define. Signed with the rest. Spec 2.5.

signableJson.description: JSON with one spelling in every language: whole numbers only, and no key that could alter an object. At most 8 levels deep, which this schema does not check.
